hooks.name: Post-edit: typecheck changed workspace
hooks.description: After a TS/TSX file is saved, run typecheck so type errors surface immediately.

action.command: INPUT=$(cat); FILE=$(printf '%s' "$INPUT" | python3 -c "import sys,json;d=json.load(sys.stdin);print(d.get('file_path') or d.get('filePath') or '')" 2>/dev/null); ROOT=$(git rev-parse --show-toplevel 2>/dev/null) || exit 0; cd "$ROOT" || exit 0; case "$FILE" in *"/infra/"*) WS=infra;; *"/services/"*) WS=services;; *"/web/"*) WS=web;; *) exit 0;; esac; echo "[post-edit hook] typecheck ($WS)..." >&2; npm --workspace "$WS" run typecheck >/tmp/ss_tc.log 2>&1 && echo "[post-edit hook] $WS typecheck OK" >&2 || { echo "[post-edit hook] $WS typecheck errors:" >&2; tail -25 /tmp/ss_tc.log >&2; }; exit 0
